match_rules.description: How script.js picks a topic: lowercase the prompt, score each topic by how many of its keywords appear as WHOLE WORDS (match with word boundaries, e.g. new RegExp('\\b' + kw + '\\b')), so short keywords like 'yo' don't match inside 'sayo'. Add +2 for each regex pattern that matches. Pick the highest score above min_score, otherwise use the fallback.

language_rules.description: Replies match the language of the prompt. 'answers' = English pool. 'answers_tl' = Tagalog/Taglish pool (optional). The site detects Tagalog function words in the prompt: detected -> picks answers_tl (falls back to answers), not detected -> picks answers (falls back to answers_tl). Keep the two pools translations of each other for the best experience.
